argv: Capture from Chronicle and the journal (HC1-HC15, decision 0112; JN1-JN24, decision 0155)
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on an iPhone and an Android phone, open Memories at rest; tap the camera under "What’s on your mind?", then the mic, then Stop; pull the page down and tap the bar's camera; tap the "+" before the line. **Expect:** no bar above the tab bar at rest; the camera and the mic sit under the placeholder's first letter; Stop takes the mic's place in the row; pulled down, the bar comes up with the pen, the camera and the mic; the "+" raises the keyboard with the caret on the line, and the row moves to the bar on the keyboard. (JN34-JN38)
